result.title: 電力消費月資料
result.description:
1.資料內涵：呈現我國20年各月電力消費按全國及部門別，並另提供各部門主要行業別用電量統計資料。
2.收集目的：做為我國能源相關政策規劃與管理之依據。
3.收集方式：
(1)能源部門自用：記錄發電廠廠用電量、售電業銷售各能源供應業電量，以及各能源供應業之自發自用電量。來自發電業、售電業及自用發電設備業者申報統計值。
(2)工業部門：記錄工業部門各業別自用發電設備廠用或自用電量，以及售電業銷售各行業別電量。來自售電業及自用發電設備業者申報統計值。
(3)運輸部門：記錄鐵路及捷運運輸系統之軌道用電量，油品管線運輸用電量，以及電動運具（公路）用電量。來自鐵路、大眾運輸以及石油煉製業者申報統計值；另電動運具（公路）電力消費統計，採用推估方式。
(4)農業部門：記錄農牧林業及漁業自用發電設備廠用或自用電量，以及售電業銷售各行業別電量。來自售電業及自用發電設備業者申報統計值。
(5)服務業部門：記錄服務業部門各業別自用發電設備廠用或自用電量，以及售電業銷售各行業別電量；來自售電業及自用發電設備業者申報統計值。
(6)住宅部門：記錄售電業銷售「家庭用（住宅用）」電量，來自售電業申報統計
4.資料分段

en.title: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Bureau of Energy_ Monthly Electricity Consumption Data
en.description: 1. Data content: Present the national and sectoral electricity consumption in the country, and provide statistical data on electricity consumption in major industries in each sector.2. Purpose of collection: As the basis for the planning and management of energy-related policies in our country.3. Collection methods:(1) Energy sector self-use: Record the electricity consumption of power plants used by the power generation sector, the electricity sales of public utility supply industries, and the self-generated electricity consumption of various energy supply industries. Reported statistical values from power generation, electricity sales, and self-generation equipment operators.(2) Industrial sector: Record the self-use of power generation equipment or self-generated electricity consumption in various industries within the industrial sector, as well as the electricity sales in various industries by public utility supply industries. Reported statistical values from electricity sales and self-generation equipment operators.(3) Transportation sector: Record the electricity consumption of railway and metro transportation systems, as well as the electricity consumption for oil pipeline transportation. The former is from railway and mass transit operators' reported statistical values, and the latter is from petroleum refining industry operators' reported statistical values.(4) Agricultural sector: Record the self-use of power generation equipment or self-generated electricity consumption in agriculture, animal husbandry, forestry, and fishery, as well as the electricity sales in various industries by public utility supply industries. Reported statistical values from electricity sales and self-generation equipment operators.(5) Service sector: Record the self-use of power generation equipment or self-generated electricity consumption in various industries within the service sector, as well as the electricity sales in various industries by public utility supply industries; reported statistical values from electricity sales and self-generation equipment operators.(6) Residential sector: Record the electricity sales for "household (residential)" use by public utility supply industries; reported statistical values from electricity sales.
